# Bhandari Ventures

> AI automation and digital growth studio in Bharatpur, Nepal. We build websites, Android apps, business automation, and AI agents (chatbots) that help businesses attract customers, cut manual work, and grow.

## About

Bhandari Ventures is an AI automation and digital growth studio based in Bharatpur, Nepal. We serve local businesses across Nepal — shops, restaurants, salons, clinics, and service businesses — and work remotely with clients worldwide. We handle the technology so business owners don't have to, and we explain everything in plain English or Nepali. Our work is open source and verifiable on GitHub.

## Services

- **Website Design & Development** — fast, mobile-friendly websites that bring in customers and are easy to update.
- **Android App Development** — custom apps for shops, restaurants, salons, and services.
- **Business Automation** — WhatsApp/SMS auto-replies, online bookings, invoicing, and reminders that save hours every week.
- **AI Agent Builder** — AI chatbots that answer customers, take orders, and book appointments 24/7.

## Ecosystem (divisions)

- AI Automation Studio
- Digital Growth Agency
- Software Products
- Future Investments
